title: ID0376462-DC/Si-D/FI[nFJBZS]-Charger OoO after v5.0.19 and dispenser
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charger OoO and offline. We had installed v5.0.19 before the bug with dispenser was known. Now charger is once again OoO and also offline. We did not reboot the charger.
Root cause:
FW bug
Solution:
Restart PLC locally
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
